title: Staging Worker deployment artifact import closure

phases.objective: Make the governed Staging Worker deployment artifact self-contained by rebasing the generated route-policy module import from source-tree topology to the co-located artifact topology, while preserving exact-SHA identity, signed attestation, Staging-only authority, and fail-closed deployment behavior.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: staging-main-deploy-eligibility.yml is explicitly dispatched for an exact current main SHA with DEPLOY_STAGING_ACTIVATION_WORKER confirmation.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Wrangler can bundle the exact-SHA Staging Worker from the generated artifact without resolving files outside the artifact directory, deploy only mad4b-activation-gateway-staging, and the public Staging health readback proves the exact deployed source SHA with stale=false.
steps: Build the Staging Worker artifact from the exact authorized source SHA and generate the signed short-lived deployment attestation.
Derive the route-policy module specifier from the checked-in source paths and rewrite only the deployment artifact to reference the co-located route-policy.staging.json file.

Fail closed if the source policy import is absent or duplicated, if the built artifact still depends on the source-tree generated directory, or if the artifact no longer references its co-located policy.
Run the existing Staging deployment contract and repository governance checks without database, migration, Production, ruleset, or unrelated provider mutation.
After merge, explicitly dispatch the governed Staging Worker deployment for the exact current main SHA and require Wrangler publish plus public exact-SHA health readback to succeed.
assertions: The checked-in edge/activation-gateway/src/worker-staging.mjs topology remains unchanged; only the generated deployment artifact import is rebased.
The artifact contains worker-staging.mjs, gateway.mjs, and route-policy.staging.json with the Worker importing the co-located policy rather than ../generated/route-policy.staging.json.
The builder derives module specifiers from filesystem paths instead of introducing new configuration candidates or configuration-drift baseline exceptions.
Exact source SHA, deterministic bundle hash, ephemeral Ed25519 signing, existing Cloudflare credential boundaries, and deployment attestation semantics remain unchanged.
The change requires live Staging certification and grants no Production mutation authority.
No database mutation, migration apply, Production deployment, ruleset mutation, credential payload read, or unrelated provider mutation is performed by this declaration or its static verification.

phases.objective: This repair grants no Production Worker deployment, Production provider mutation, Production credential access, database mutation, or production_live authority.
blockers: Production deployment requires a separate governed Production promotion and explicit authorization.
This PR is scoped to the Staging Worker artifact and its live non-production certification only.
